items.title: DDOG Q2 Deep Dive: Market Reacts Negatively Despite Accelerating Core Growth and AI Momentum
items.summary: Cloud monitoring platform Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) reported Q2 CY2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 35.6% year on year to $1.12 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was optimistic at $1.14 billion at the midpoint, 2.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.65 per share was 11.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
